title: Artificial intelligence-based algorithm for predicting outcomes in early-stage lung cancer: An annotation-free imaging artificial intelligence study.
summary: The study constructs an annotation-free CT image model for recurrence/survival outcomes, developing in three clinical-trial cohorts and refining/testing in an external hospital cohort of 1,366 patients; model ablations compare imaging with clinical/pathologic inputs.
